question: Which of the following is a green alga found in vast masses of a variety of marine and fresh waters?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cladophora**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Cladophora** is a genus of green algae found in vast masses in various marine and fresh waters.
 
• It belongs to the family **Cladophoraceae** and is characterized by its branched filamentous structure.
